{{Quote|Yes, sir.|Llerd|<ref name="Crosscurrent" />}}
'''Llerd''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] serving the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow's]] [[Sith invasion fleet]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] aboard the [[Sith dreadnaught]] [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']]. He unhesitatingly accepted orders from his superiors and enjoyed watching his enemies [[Death/Legends|die]]. During the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], when ''Harbinger'' was on a mission to acquire [[Lignan]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] in the [[Phaegon system/Legends|Phaegon system]], it was [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|ambushed]] by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relin Druur]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] attempted to enter [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], but its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] had been heavily damaged, causing it to misjump and [[Time travel/Legends|travel]] over 5,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] into the future to [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]].

Llerd was promoted to [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] by ''Harbinger''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|captain]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Saes Rrogon]], and he oversaw both the reparations of the [[Warship/Legends|warship's]] instrumentation and the pursuit of an [[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|enemy freighter]] by [[Blade-class starfighter|''Blade''-class starfighters]]. When Rrogon discovered that Druur, who had traveled in [[Time/Legends|time]] with them, had again boarded ''Harbinger'', Llerd hunted for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] from the warship's secondary bridge. He was killed when Druur used the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to [[Mission to the Harbinger|destroy]] the [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]].

==Biography==
===Mission to Phaegon III===
{{Quote|You are acting executive officer, ''Colonel'' Llerd.|Saes Rrogon, promoting Llerd|<ref name="Crosscurrent" />}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Llerd was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] [[Standard day/Legends|night]]-watch crew of the [[Sith dreadnaught]] [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. The [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] served in the [[Sith invasion fleet]] of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow's]] [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], and in that year, the Empire was fighting the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Sadow dispatched ''Harbinger'' and its sister [[Starship/Legends|ship]], ''[[Omen]]'', to the [[Phaegon system/Legends|Phaegon system]] to obtain [[Lignan]], a rare [[Ore/Legends|ore]] powerful in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], hoping to use the ore to bolster his forces at the upcoming [[Battle of Kirrek (Great Hyperspace War)|Battle of Kirrek]]. Llerd was off-duty while the two [[Warship/Legends|warships]] [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombarded]] the [[Phaegon III's largest moon|largest moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phaegon III]] and exposed the Lignan beneath its crust.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

During the bombardment, ''Harbinger'' was [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|boarded]] by the Republic-affiliated [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relin Druur]], who aimed to prevent the ship from delivering its Lignan cargo to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] damaged ''Harbinger''{{'s}} [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] with [[Mag-grenade|explosives]], and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Drev Hassin]], [[Ramming/Legends|crashed]] his [[Infiltrator (starfighter)|Infiltrator]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] into the warship's bridge [[Standard second|seconds]] before it attempted to flee into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The compounded damage caused ''Harbinger'' to misjump, failing to fully enter a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace tunnel]] and [[Time travel/Legends|traveling through time]] to the year [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]].<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

Away from the bridge, [[Saes Rrogon]]&mdash;one of Sadow's [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] and the ship's [[Captain/Legends|captain]]&mdash;was able to [[Telekinesis/Legends|use]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to pull the ship back into [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] in an [[UR-2212-GR system/Legends|unfamiliar system]], and he ordered all members of the bridge night-watch crew to the secondary bridge. Unaware of ''Harbinger''{{'s}} new temporal location, Llerd arrived at the bridge and, noticing that the ship's instrumentation was down, ordered a full stop. He alerted his crew when Rrogon arrived on the bridge, and he was promoted to [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] on the spot by the captain, replacing the [[Los Dor|former colonel]] who had [[Death/Legends|died]] with the rest of the regular bridge crew. Llerd was also named the acting [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]], and he was tasked with both overseeing repairs of the instrumentation and scanning surrounding space in an effort to determine their location.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

After further consideration, Rrogon instructed him to order security to perform a room-by-room sweep of the ship in a search for Druur. Llerd began his assigned repair work, and ''Harbinger''{{'s}} systems slowly came back online. When the scanners became operational, they revealed the presence of a nearby [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|disk-like freighter]] and one of ''Harbinger''{{'s}} [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]], and Llerd was ordered to fire on the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] by Rrogon, who suspected that Druur was rendezvousing with other [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]]. ''Harbinger''{{'s}} weapons systems were still offline, however, and Llerd was consequently ordered to deploy two [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[Blade-class starfighter|''Blade''-class starfighters]] to attack the freighter.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

===Destruction of ''Harbinger''===
{{Quote|Our pilots reported that ship destroyed.''"<br />"''Yes, sir. It appears they were&hellip; incorrect.''"<br />"''They were duped.|Saes Rrogon and Llerd discuss ''Junker''|<ref name="Crosscurrent" />}}
[[File:Saes.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Saes Rrogon, Llerd's captain]]
The freighter, named [[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|''Junker'']], fled into the rings of the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Unidentified gas giant (UR-2212-GR system)|gas giant]], and Llerd relayed an order of Rrogon's to the Blade [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to pursue. The ship's [[Scientist/Legends|science]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[8L6]], then informed Rrogon of the [[Time/Legends|time]] travel that had occurred, and, wanting his crew to remain ignorant and thus focused on their objective, Rrogon ordered Llerd not to monitor or scan any local [[Subspace/Legends|subspace]] channels. Llerd was eager to see ''Junker'' destroyed, and when it jettisoned its cargo into an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], the resulting explosion caused him to believe that the Blade starfighters had succeeded. Rrogon shared his belief and ordered the colonel to put ''Harbinger'' into [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant's]] [[frozen moon]]. Llerd was also told not to plot a course to [[Primus Goluud/Legends|Primus Goluud]], where he believed Sadow's fleet would still be, should the hyperdrive be fixed. The captain then retreated to his quarters, content that the Jedi had been killed.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

Several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] later, however, ''Junker'' appeared in realspace beneath ''Harbinger'' and penetrated its [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], entering the warship's [[Hangar/Legends|landing bay]]. Cautious of potential explosives aboard the freighter, Llerd dispatched all available security to the bay and isolated the area. He then [[Comlink/Legends|commed]] Rrogon, who [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] that Druur was aboard ''Junker'' and had [[Mission to the Harbinger|infiltrated]] ''Harbinger''. Llerd attempted to locate the Jedi but found only a trail of bodies. Rrogon commed him back and revealed that Druur was in the ship's cargo bay, and Llerd prepared to call security but was halted by the captain&mdash;Rrogon would face the Jedi alone. Llerd acquiesced and evacuated all personnel from the cargo bay. Rrogon then [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|engaged]] Druur in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]], but he was killed by the Jedi, who, having fallen to the dark side, drew in power from the Lignan in the cargo bay and used the Force to consume the ship in [[Fire/Legends|flames]], killing Llerd and everyone else on board.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Blades are entering the rings in pursuit.|Llerd, eager to see ''Junker'' destroyed|<ref name="Crosscurrent" />}}
Llerd was a barrel-chested, round-faced man who served Naga Sadow's Sith fleet as a lieutenant. He was respectful to his superior [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and unhesitatingly accepted orders, even if they perplexed him or placed others' lives in danger. When he ordered Blade starfighters to pursue ''Junker'', he was eager to see his quarry die, and his face became flush when he believed that they had been killed. While observing Saes Rrogon tap a [[Blood/Legends|bleeding]] finger against a jaw horn, Llerd watched his captain as if hypnotized but regained his composure when Rrogon began to speak.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

==Behind the scenes==
Llerd was created by author [[Paul S. Kemp]] for his [[2010]] novel, ''[[Crosscurrent]]''.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />
